evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies HTTP server framing logic in src/httpserver.cpp.
rationale: Hardens the HTTP server against request framing ambiguities by strictly rejecting unsupported or multiple Transfer-Encoding headers in compliance with RFC 9112 section 6.3. LoadBody previously checked only the first header and fell back to Content-Length or reading an empty body on invalid codings, creating potential parsing desynchronization vulnerabilities.
